fixed.explanation: configFromCLIOptions passes the proxy URL as server without extracting credentials. The fix parses the URL, moves percent-decoded username and password into the proxy fields, and strips them from the server string.

query.intent: The MCP command-line config parser builds the browser proxy settings from the --proxy-server option. It must parse the proxy URL and pass the username and password, percent-decoded, as the proxy credentials in the launch options.
query.symptom: Credentials embedded in the proxy URL passed on the command line are ignored, so authenticated proxies fail.

history.analysis: The server-side proxy code handles username/password only when given separately. The MCP CLI config parser, which builds launch options from --proxy-server, is not yet seen. It should parse the URL and set username and password, percent-decoded.
